request.spec:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a
duplicate would be. People who already clash are not changed: each shows clashing yes, and every
edit of them through the person form is refused until the edit renames them to a name that does not
clash (and leaves no clashing alias).

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A name or alias may no longer be used on a sheet when any sheet of its tree (its ancestors, its
descendants and their descendants, among the sheets that exist) already uses it as a name or alias:
adding, renaming, an alias, the quick-add bar, the paste box (and any later import) are refused as a

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The change is in, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**How it works**
- A sheet's "tree" means its ancestors (parent, grandparent, and so on) plus all its descendants, counting only sheets that exist. I didn't include siblings or cousins. That's my reading of "its ancestors, its descendants and their descendants"; if you meant the whole family of sheets, it's a small change in one method.
- Names and aliases are compared the way the app already compares them: ignoring case and surrounding spaces.

**What is now refused** (each shows its usual error and writes nothing):
- **Adding a person** whose name is already a name or alias anywhere in the tree.
- **Adding an alias** that is already a name or alias anywhere in the tree.
- **Quick-add**, when the name isn't on this sheet and would create a new person whose name is used elsewhere in the tree.
- **Paste box:** a pasted name that isn't on this sheet was already refused, so this needed no change.
- **Editing a person through the form**, if the saved name or any of their existing aliases is used elsewhere in the tree. So a person who already clashes can't be edited until the edit renames them clear of the clash, and only if none of their aliases clash either.

**What is shown:** each person row has a new `person-clashing` field showing `yes` or `no`. It is worked out from the current data each time the sheet loads, so no data migration was needed.

**Main changes**
- `PersonRepository.java` has the new tree lookup and the check behind the clashing flag.
- `Person.java` carries the new `clashing` field.
- The checks are in `AddPerson`, `AddAlias`, `ApplyPerson` and `FindOrAddPerson`.
- On the front end, `features/people/api.ts` and `People.tsx` have the new field and the column.

**Left unchanged on purpose:** moving a person to another sheet (transfer) and merging two people. The request doesn't list them, and transfer still checks only the destination sheet itself. Bulk grade changes don't go through the person form, so a clashing person can still be bulk-graded.
